title:
Copilot built me the work dashboard Microsoft forgot to make.
It scans my Microsoft 365 workspace and turns everything into one live command center:
• What I need to do
• What deserves my attention
• People I need to chase
• Commitments I’ve made
• Meetings and available focus time
• Emails and threads quietly slipping through the cracks
• My 3 biggest priorities right now
But the useful part is that it doesn’t just display data.
It tries to figure out what actually matters, shows the evidence behind every inference, and tells me the next move.
The prompt also makes Copilot build everything first and wait for approval before creating the recurring refresh.
Comment WORK and I’ll send you the full prompt + dashboard template.
